qualifier: exogenous antigen processing, including germinal center B cells, plus regulation
name: Exogenous antigen processing and MHC class II presentation with regulation
rationale: All members concern MHC class II peptide antigen presentation; unlike the regulation-only theme already using the requested name, this theme also contains the core exogenous antigen processing and presentation pathways (MHC class II antigen presentation, exogenous peptide via MHC class II, germinal center B cell antigen processing), and unlike C4 it is class II rather than class I cross-presentation.

core: MHC class II antigen presentation regulation
qualifier: peptide-MHC class II assembly, without exogenous antigen processing
name: Peptide-MHC class II assembly and presentation regulation
rationale: All members concern controlling MHC class II peptide presentation (positive and negative regulation, peptide-MHC II complex assembly, antigen presentation modules); it lacks the exogenous antigen processing, germinal center B cell and general MHC class II presentation pathways that C1 and C2 contain, and the monocyte/lipid antigen content of C3 and C4.
